Taliyah|sup.identity: Control mage. Rock Surfing (passive): she moves faster near walls. Threaded Volley (Q) fires a volley of rocks and creates worked ground under her; cast again on that ground, it consumes it to throw a big boulder that slows. Seismic Shove (W) erupts the ground and knocks enemies in the chosen direction, Unraveled Earth (E) lays a minefield that slows; an enemy who dashes or is knocked onto it detonates the mines and is stunned. Weaver's Wall (R) creates a very long wall she can surf on.
Taliyah|sup.playstyle: Control support: she lays her mines, then knocks her opponent onto them with W for the stun, and cuts fights apart with her wall.
Taliyah|sup.early_game: Poke with Threaded Volley (Q). Look for the E → W combo: lay the mines, then knock your opponent through them for the stun. Supports who dash (hooks, charges) set off your mines themselves: place them in front of your ADC.
Taliyah|sup.level_1: Threaded Volley (Q) first. After that, max Q first.
Taliyah|sup.level_2: Unraveled Earth (E). Mines in front of your ADC: an enemy engage triggers the stun.
Taliyah|sup.level_3: Seismic Shove (W). Combo: E, then W to knock your opponent through the mines.
Taliyah|sup.level_6: Weaver's Wall: a very long wall that blocks the way. Cut off the enemy's escape, split the enemy team in two, or use it to roam by surfing on it.
power_spikes: Level 6: wall to cut fights apart.
First completed item: stronger Q poke.
Mid game: fast roams thanks to your passive and wall.
Taliyah|sup.lane_plan: Poke with Q, lay your mines against engages and play the E → W combo. Stay in the bot lane until level 5: since patch 26.16, your minion gold and XP are cut by a third elsewhere. The support role quest then makes your Control Wards cheaper (40 gold, two stored).
Taliyah|sup.trading: Basic trade: Q. All-in: E → W through the mines → Q. Defense: mines in front of your ADC, W to knock back a diver. Against hooks (Blitzcrank), stay behind minions.
mistakes: Knocking your opponent with W with no mines behind them.
Placing the wall so it blocks your own ADC.
Wasting E to poke instead of keeping it against an engage.

matchup_notes.Thresh: Place your mines in front of your ADC: his engage sets them off.
matchup_notes.Lulu: She pokes: play the E → W combo rather than trades.
matchup_notes.Nautilus: His anchor pulls him forward onto your mines.
matchup_notes.Nami: Dodge her bubble and stay at range.

Taliyah|sup.mid_game: Roam thanks to your speed near walls, place Control Wards and cut off paths with your ultimate.
Taliyah|sup.late_game: Stay behind your frontline, lay your mines in front of your carry and knock divers onto them with W. The wall splits the enemy team in two.
Taliyah|sup.ahead: Roam and create picks with your wall.
Taliyah|sup.behind: Protect your ADC with your mines and W.
Taliyah|sup.win_condition: To win this game, you want to control the terrain with your mines and wall and stun enemy engages.
Taliyah|sup.final_tip: Dashes and knock-ups set off your mines: place them where your opponent will engage, then W to finish the job.
